narrative_purpose: Teaches swarm decision-making with no decider: scout bees dance for two candidate sites, inspect each other's finds, and one site wins purely because the count of scouts there crosses a threshold — the whole swarm tips on a quorum, with no central bee in charge.
subject: A clustered swarm of small insects hanging from a branch at lower centre; thin glowing flight-paths arcing out to two distant hollows; a faint looping dance-path traced over the cluster; at one hollow the gathered scouts are visibly denser and brighter, crossing a softly marked ring-threshold so that hollow reads as the winner, while the other hollow stays sparse and dim; deliberately no single large directing insect anywhere.
scene: A dim forest clearing, the swarm-branch foreground, two tree-hollows in the mid distance, haze beyond.
camera: A wide naturalist three-quarter view taking in the cluster and both candidate hollows.
light: Bioluminescent cyan key from the swarm cluster and the flight-paths; the winning hollow glows brighter as more scouts gather; the losing hollow dim.
palette: Void-indigo base, Pandora cyan dominant for the swarm and paths, living teal on the foliage, a faint warm amber spark only at the winning hollow's threshold.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the cluster and the two hollows; flight-paths and far forest softening into haze.
composition: Cluster low-centre, two hollows upper-left and upper-right, the brighter winner offset so dark space remains for labels.
consistency_notes: Earth-science figure rendered in the book's cool palette and from-within glow; keep open dark regions beside the cluster and each hollow for callouts.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
